title: Harbor and Compass
author: Bram Reyes
blurb: Dominic Underhill, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
